input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every case is boxes, labels, or points written out in the capture tool; the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.

upstream.capture_method: The pinned functions were imported and executed, not transcribed.

limitations: Leaf primitives only. The insert functions and child-block updaters above them require the LayoutBlock/LayoutRegion object model, which is the named next unit of STRUCT-001 work.
sort_normal_blocks quantizes with Python floor division; the Rust port floors on f64, which agrees for every finite input the pipeline can produce.
No model is run and no page is decoded.
